title: Healthy, Micah McFadden eager to work with new Giants LB Tremaine Edmunds in return

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Healthy, Micah McFadden eager to work with new Giants LB Tremaine Edmunds in return
sources.description: After missing all of last season to injury, LB Micah McFadden is happy to be back with the Giants on a one-year deal.
